title: bug: the dependency auto-unblock returns a still-assigned hold to its parked worker but leaves that worker BLOCKED with the resolved block's lastError (the resource grant path repairs it, 07af3ca5)
description:
Files: packages/moe-daemon/src/state/dependencyUnblock.ts and packages/moe-daemon/src/state/dependencyUnblock.test.ts. resourceStore.ts changes only if the worker repair is extracted into a shared helper. No open row declares any of these files. I checked the plan files of every non-DONE row at 2026-11-02 20:51Z.

Defect, read at HEAD 3e092cff:
- A third-party report_blocked on an assigned task keeps the seat and marks the worker BLOCKED with lastError set to the reason (reportBlocked.ts:386-387).
- When every blockedOnTaskIds target lands, runDependencyUnblock restores the task to blockedFromStatus. While the worker still points at the task, it also restores the task onto that worker (dependencyUnblock.ts:241-253). It writes no worker update, and because assignedWorkerId is passed explicitly, updateTask's prior-owner handling is skipped.
- The resource grant path repairs the same seat. grantNextLeases flips a BLOCKED owner whose currentTaskId is the task back to READING_CONTEXT, clears lastError and keeps lastActivityAt (resourceStore.ts:552-566). Commit 07af3ca5 added that after task-9f6c9938 showed a WORKING task whose worker still reported BLOCKED.
- Result:
  - list_workers and the board show a BLOCKED worker on a WORKING task until that worker's next claim, start_step or complete_step.
  - Meanwhile runBlockedTimeoutSweep (sweeps.ts:411-460) acts on any worker whose status is BLOCKED. Once that worker's lastActivityAt is older than blockedTimeoutMs, the sweep parks the restored WORKING task to BACKLOG.
  - A governor's routine unblock_worker on the "BLOCKED" seat releases the resumed row.
- The parity test at dependencyUnblock.test.ts:152 ('a still-assigned hold returns to its parked worker (grantNextLeases parity)') sets the worker BLOCKED but asserts only the task's status and assignee.

Reach: a third-party or legacy still-assigned dependency block whose prerequisites land while the seat still points at the task. The display error is certain whenever that happens; the BACKLOG park needs the sweep to run before the seat's next moe call.

Origin: hunt requested by governor-e6b40560 (msg-5fe3b1537cb04b50964bd0edf07db4c8). 07af3ca5 fixed only the resource path. No row mentions the dependency path's worker state.
definitionOfDone: When runDependencyUnblock restores a task onto its still-assigned worker, and that worker's status is BLOCKED with currentTaskId equal to the task, the worker becomes READING_CONTEXT. Its lastError becomes null, its lastActivityAt stays unchanged, and a WORKER_UNBLOCKED event is written; this is the same rule grantNextLeases applies.
A worker that is not BLOCKED, that points at another task, or that is DEAD is left untouched. A failed worker write is logged and never undoes the task restore.

Tests: the parity test at dependencyUnblock.test.ts:152 also asserts the worker's status, lastError and lastActivityAt. A new case shows that after the restore, runBlockedTimeoutSweep run past blockedTimeoutMs leaves the restored task WORKING and assigned. RED first against the unchanged code, with the failing output quoted.

`cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/state/dependencyUnblock.test.ts src/state/resourceStore.lifecycle.test.ts src/tools/reportBlocked.test.ts` exits 0. Run it in the task's worktree or in a git-archive snapshot, never as an in-place build or test in the shared control checkout. Its output is the complete_task evidence.
Only dependencyUnblock.ts and its test change, plus resourceStore.ts if the repair moves into a shared helper (grant behaviour unchanged, its lifecycle tests pass).
reopenReason: Human "move from backlog"; architect hunt row: dependency auto-unblock leaves the restored seat BLOCKED with a stale lastError.
